05:45CF.name: AnyFoeLacksStatus1Bit0
05:45CF.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 1 (wD80D) bit 0 clear, else 0 (E-0099)

05:45E1.name: AnyFoeLacksStatus1Bit7
05:45E1.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 1 (wD80D) bit 7 clear, else 0 (E-0099)

05:4767.name: AnyAllyLacksStatus2Bit6
05:4767.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's own three slots (the actor included) is present with status byte 2 (wD80E) bit 6 clear, else 0 (E-0099)

05:48C9.name: AnyFoeOpenToSlotResistances1Field0
05:48C9.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 1 bit 1 clear, status byte 5 & $03 clear and the low 2 bits of its wDA73 entry not 3, else 0 (E-0099) (E-0340: the address in its name read as its RAM name; was AnyFoeOpenToWDA73Field0)

05:49DD.name: AnyFoeOpenToSlotResistances4Field0
05:49DD.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 0 & $03 clear and the low 2 bits of its wDA76 entry not 3, else 0 (E-0099) (E-0340: the address in its name read as its RAM name; was AnyFoeOpenToWDA76Field0)

05:4A10.name: AnyFoeOpenToSlotResistances5Field3
05:4A10.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 0 bit 6 clear and bits 7-6 of its wDA77 entry not both set, else 0 (E-0099) (E-0340: the address in its name read as its RAM name; was AnyFoeOpenToWDA77Field3)

05:4B7A.name: AnyOwnSideSlotOutIs1
05:4B7A.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's side's three wBattleSlotOut bytes is 1, else 0 (E-0099)

05:4CE5.name: CheckFoeStatus7Bit2
05:4CE5.note: C = 1 when the AI mode (wDA53[actor]) is below 3; otherwise C = 0 when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 7 (wD813) bit 2 set, else $FF (E-0099)

05:4D1A.name: AnyAllyLacksStatus1Bits23And4Bits01
05:4D1A.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's own three slots is present (the actor included) with status byte 1 (wD80D) & $0C clear and status byte 4 & $03 clear, else 0 (E-0099)

05:4DF5.name: CheckSide0FlagNot1
05:4DF5.note: C = 0 when the actor's side byte (wC984 for slots 0-3, wC985 for 4-7) is 1, else C = $FF (E-0099)

05:459D.name: AnyFoeLacksStatus5Bits01And1Bit1
05:459D.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 5 (wD811) & $03 clear and status byte 1 (wD80D) bit 1 clear, else 0 (E-0100)

05:4949.name: AnyFoeWithMPOpenToSlotResistances2Field1
05:4949.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with non-zero MP (GetBattleMP_Bank05) and bits 3-2 of its wDA74 entry not both set, else 0 (E-0100) (E-0340: the address in its name read as its RAM name; was AnyFoeWithMPOpenToWDA74Field1)

05:4B3D.name: AtLeastTwoFoesPresent
05:4B3D.note: C = $FF when at least two of the actor's three opposite slots are present, else 0 (the opposite of FewerThanTwoFoesPresent) (E-0100)

05:53E6.name: ActorLacksStatus4Bits45
05:53E6.note: C = 0 when the actor's status byte 4 (wD810) & $30 is set, else C = $FF (E-0100)

05:558B.name: ActorMPBelowThreeQuarters
05:558B.note: C = $FF when 4 x the actor's MP is below 3 x its max MP (MP under three quarters of max), else 0 (E-0100)

05:5CCE.name: CheckBattleKindNot2Or3
05:5CCE.note: C = 0 when wCFC5 is 2 or 3, else C = $FF (E-0100)

05:5D20.name: AnyAllyLacksStatus2Bit2
05:5D20.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's own three slots (the actor included) is present with status byte 2 (wD80E) bit 2 clear (AnySlotLacksStatusMask), else 0 (E-0100)

05:5D31.name: AnyAllyLacksStatus2Bit2_2
05:5D31.note: the same test as AnyAllyLacksStatus2Bit2: C = $FF when one of the actor's own three slots (the actor included) is present with status byte 2 bit 2 clear. It computes the side with `and a, $04` twice where the opposite-side predicates use `and a, $04 / xor a, $04`, so it probably meant the foes (a possible slip; not executed) (E-0100) (E-0344: the address in its name dropped or read as the label there; was AnyAllyLacksStatus2Bit2_5D31)

05:5D9B.name: AnyFoeOpenToSlotResistances2Field3
05:5D9B.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 0 bit 7 clear and bits 7-6 of its wDA74 entry not both set, else 0 (E-0100) (E-0340: the address in its name read as its RAM name; was AnyFoeOpenToWDA74Field3)

05:6481.name: CheckBattleKindAtLeast2OrLinkModeSet
05:6481.note: C = 0 when wC58A is 0 and wCFC5 is below 2, else C = $FF (E-0100)

05:64CC.name: CheckActorSlot0To3OrLinkModeSet
05:64CC.note: C = 0 when wC58A is 0 and the actor is in slots 4-7, else C = $FF (E-0100)

05:6FBD.name: AnySlotHasStatusMask
05:6FBD.note: A = first slot, B = slot count, HL = a status field (wBattleStatus + n), E = mask: C = $FF when some present slot in the range has (HL + 9 * slot) & E non-zero, else C = 0 (the opposite test to AnySlotLacksStatusMask) (E-0100)

03:460B.name: MenuCursorPositions_Bank03
03:460B.note: ten BG map addresses: rows 3, 5, 7, 9, 11 and 13 of column 1 ($9861 ... $99A1) and rows 1, 3, 5 and 7 of column 9 ($9829 ... $98E9), indexed by the cursor slot (wC46D & 3 or & 7) by the bank-$03 menu cursor routines (E-0101)

03:4414.name: CopyTenBytesToTextBuf0
03:4414.note: copies 10 bytes from HL to wC130 and writes $F0 after them; HL advances; BC kept (E-0101)

03:451C.name: DrawMenuCursorTileInBuffer
03:451C.note: writes the cursor tile $BB into wScreenTileBuffer at the position of MenuCursorPositions_Bank03[wC46D & 3] (BG map address + $2998) (E-0101)

03:7692.name: LoadScreenBlock21
03:7692.note: clears the screen tile buffer (ClearScreenTileBuffer_Bank03) and copies block $21 into it (CopyBlockToTileBuffer, E = $21) (E-0101)

03:769E.name: LoadScreenBlock21WithCursor
03:769E.note: LoadScreenBlock21, then writes tile $BC at MenuCursorPositions_Bank03[wC46D & 7] in the buffer (WriteBCTileToScreenBufferAtTableEntry_Bank03) (E-0101)

03:641E.name: LoadScreenBlocks1CAnd0C
03:641E.note: clears the screen tile buffer and copies blocks $1C and $0C into it (CopyBlockToTileBuffer) (E-0101)

03:5900.name: ShowSelectedItemDescription
03:5900.note: inventory slot = (wMenuPage & $0F) * 4 + (wC46E & $0F): shows that item's string of category 6 (the item descriptions of the bank-$08 database; item $1F uses string $6F) at vTiles2 + $230 with size $1203 (ShowStringBank08AtTilesHL_Bank03) (E-0101)

30:4F14.name: RunHandlersForSetBitsInBC
30:4F14.note: for bit numbers 0-15 in turn (BitMaskWords16): when the bit is set in BC (C for 0-7, B for 8-15), calls handler E through CallFlagBitHandlerE; stops early when a handler returns carry (E-0102)

30:4F3B.name: CallFlagBitHandlerE
30:4F3B.note: E = bit number: jumps through the 16-word handler table at $4F66 (JumpToWordAtHL) (E-0102)

16:4B4D.name: AddAToRecordWordCapped
16:4B4D.note: A = amount, record wD083 (SRAMRecordAddressMapped), field offset C: the word there += A, capped at 999 (CapDETo999) (E-0103)

16:4B68.name: AddAToRecordWordPairCapped
16:4B68.note: A = amount, record wD083 (SRAMRecordAddressMapped), field offset C: adds A to the word at field C and to the word two bytes before it, each capped at 999 (E-0103)

16:4B97.name: SubtractAFromRecordWordFloor1
16:4B97.note: A = amount, record wD083 (SRAMRecordAddressMapped), field offset C: leaves the word unchanged when it is 999; otherwise word -= A, but never below 1 (E-0103)

16:466A.name: ShowRaiseAmountOrRefuse
16:466A.note: HL = cap, BC = current value: when they are equal sets wItemId = $FF (refuse); otherwise writes min(HL - BC, wD08F) (wD08F when the difference is 256 or more) as a decimal string at wC160 (WriteDecimalByteString) (E-0103)

16:58FD.name: StoreHLToRecordField
16:58FD.note: A = record (SRAMRecordAddressMapped), C = field offset: stores HL (low byte first) at that field (E-0103)

16:66B9.name: BlankTileAtTableEntryDE
16:66B9.note: HL = table of VRAM addresses, [DE] = index: writes tile $C3 at that entry's address (WriteVRAMByte); HL kept (E-0103)

16:7A64.name: LoadTilesForPartyRecords
16:7A64.note: with SRAM enabled (bank 0), runs LoadTileForRecordFamily for record list entries 0, 1 and 2 with H = $C7, $C8 and $C9, stopping after wC6FD entries; then disables SRAM (E-0103)

1D:5E3F.name: CountRecordsInUse
1D:5E3F.note: over the first wD7FF SRAM records ($A5 bytes each from sA000; wD7FF is set by LoadRecordCapacityFromFarmLevelTable): wD7AA = how many have byte 0 equal to 1 or 2 (in use) (E-0104)

1D:5ECE.name: ListRecordsState1NotEggs
1D:5ECE.note: over the first wD7FF SRAM records ($A5 bytes each from sA000; wD7FF is set by LoadRecordCapacityFromFarmLevelTable): clears the 30-byte list wD789, then appends the number of every record whose byte 0 is 1 and byte $6E is 0; wD7A9 = the list length, wD7B9 = how many state-1 records had byte $6E set (E-0104) (E-0345: record byte $6E is MON_EGG; was ListRecordsState1WithByte6EClear)

1D:5F2D.name: ListRecordsInUseNotEggs
1D:5F2D.note: over the first wD7FF SRAM records ($A5 bytes each from sA000; wD7FF is set by LoadRecordCapacityFromFarmLevelTable): clears wD789 and wD7BE (30 bytes each), then appends every record whose byte 0 is 1 or 2 and byte $6E is 0; wD7A9 = the list length, wD7B9 = how many in-use records had byte $6E set (E-0104) (E-0345: record byte $6E is MON_EGG; was ListRecordsInUseWithByte6EClear)

1D:6026.name: ListRecordsInUseEggs
1D:6026.note: over the first wD7FF SRAM records ($A5 bytes each from sA000; wD7FF is set by LoadRecordCapacityFromFarmLevelTable): clears wD789, then appends every record whose byte 0 is 1 or 2 and byte $6E is non-zero; wD7A9 = the list length (E-0104) (C2 from E-0325: Evaluate with no egg in any record shows 'You don't have any eggs') (E-0345: record byte $6E is MON_EGG; was ListRecordsInUseWithByte6ESet)

1D:7AD8.name: UnpackByteAtHLTo2BitFieldsArg5
1D:7AD8.note: with SRAM bank wD7F2 selected, splits the byte at HL into four 2-bit fields: wD7F5 = bits 7-6, wD7F6 = bits 5-4, wD7F7 = bits 3-2, wD7F8 = bits 1-0 (E-0104)

1D:70F9.name: Pack2BitFieldsFromPackFields
1D:70F9.note: B = (wD7E2 & 3) << 6 | (wD7E3 & 3) << 4 | (wD7E4 & 3) << 2 | (wD7E5 & 3), the opposite of unpacking a byte into four 2-bit fields (E-0104)

1D:58C8.name: DrawThreeDigitsAtScrollOffset6E
1D:58C8.note: writes the three bytes at wD7CE as digit tiles ($E0 + digit) at the BG map entry BGMapAddressAtScroll + $6E (row 3, column 14 of the view), one per byte with WaitForVRAMAccess (E-0104)

1D:6973.name: DecompressGraphicsArg1ToArg4
1D:6973.note: graphics number = the word wD7F1/wD7F2: reads its far pointer (3 bytes per entry) from Data_004_4EAA in bank $04 (ReadFarPointerAtDEInBankB) and DecompressToVRAM to the address in wD7F4/wD7F5; on CGB it continues with the palette (not read) (E-0104)

1D:65F6.name: UpdateListCursorListCursor
1D:65F6.note: list cursor over wD7A9 entries: Up/Down move wD7AB with wrap, erase and redraw the cursor, play sound $69 and set wMenuInputResult = $FD; A draws the confirmed cursor, plays sound $69 and sets $FF; B sets $FE; with no input the cursor blinks and the result is 0 (the codes of UpdatePagedListCursor) (E-0106)

1D:62AD.name: DrawRecordListNameTiles_Bank1D
1D:62AD.note: with SRAM enabled, for each of the wC6FD record numbers in wC6FE copies the record's name (CopyRecordNameToNameGlyphBuf, C = 1) and draws it as glyph tiles at the VRAM address from Data_01D_62F9 (CopyGlyphTilesToVRAM); then disables SRAM (E-0106)

1D:75C7.name: CopyTenBytesThenSelectSRAMBank0
1D:75C7.note: copies 10 bytes from HL to DE, selecting SRAM bank 0 (rRAMB = 0) after each byte is read; HL and DE advance (E-0106)

12:7DF1.name: RemoveInventorySlotShiftDown
12:7DF1.note: hFFC6 = inventory slot: moves each wInventory byte after it down by one up to slot $17 (the last slot keeps its old value), then wC634 = $FF; nothing moves when the slot is $17 (E-0106)

15:683C.name: SubtractArg1AmountFromGold
15:683C.note: wGold -= the 24-bit amount wD7F3:wD7F2:wD7F1 (no floor; callers check first, for example with IsAmountInArg1AboveGold) (E-0106) (C2 from E-0327: buying a Herb at 10G turns 99,999 into 99,989)

15:6676.name: UnpackBCDToDigitsArg1
15:6676.note: wD7F1 = hFFC9, then the high and low digits of hFFC8, hFFC7 and hFFC6 go to wD7F2-wD7F7 (seven digits of a packed-BCD number, most significant first); the loop that follows (C = 6) is not read (E-0106)

1E:7564.name: DrawPageOfPagesAtScrollOffset
1E:7564.note: HL = BGMapAddressAtScroll + the offset in wD7F1 (high) / wD7F2 (low): writes tile $E0 + wD7AF + 1 there and tile $E0 + wD7B0 two entries later, each through StepBGMapAddressBackOnScrollWrap and WaitForVRAMAccess (current page and page count) (E-0106)

F1:4870.name: UpdateMenuCursor_BankF1
F1:4870.note: the same instruction sequence as UpdateMenuCursor (bank $03) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107)

F1:42D9.name: ShowSelectedItemDescription_BankF1
F1:42D9.note: the same instruction sequence as ShowSelectedItemDescription (bank $03) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107)

05:6312.name: MPBandOfSlotTemp0
05:6312.note: the same instruction sequence as HPBandOfSlotTemp0 (bank $05) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107) (E-0344: the address in its name dropped or read as the label there; was HPBandOfSlotTemp0_6312)

1B:665E.name: LinkBattleSetupMenu
1B:665E.note: a 16-step dispatcher on wScreenState laid out like EggServiceMenu (bank $0D), but only the dispatch matches: the steps are this bank's own and run a link exchange (a message, waiting for the partner, picking records, starting the link battle) rather than the egg service (E-0363; narrows E-0107) (renamed from EggServiceMenu_Bank1B from its E-0357 note, E-0367)
1B:665E.evidence: instruction diff of the two routines (E-0363)

F0:6384.name: DrawPageOfPagesAtScrollOffset_BankF0
F0:6384.note: the same instruction sequence as DrawPageOfPagesAtScrollOffset (bank $1E) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107)

A1:413F.name: RunBattleCommandEntry_BankA1
A1:413F.note: a variant of RunBattleCommandEntry (bank $30) with the same seven steps, but step 0 marks the enemy slots 4-7 instead of choosing the command-entry monster, the second random stream always advances, step 3 uses ChooseActionTarget, step 4 lists no item entry, and a skill's speed bonus is 2,000 instead of 1,000 (E-0363; corrects E-0107, which called the two the same instruction sequence)
A1:413F.evidence: instruction diff of the two routines (E-0363)

A0:5E07.name: RunBattleSetup_BankA0
A0:5E07.note: a 13-step dispatcher on wBattleSubPhase laid out like RunBattleSetup (bank $31), but only the dispatch matches: the steps are this bank's own (E-0363; narrows E-0107)
A0:5E07.evidence: instruction diff of the two routines (E-0363)

3B:4AB2.name: RollChanceByLevel_100_100_75_0_Bank3B
3B:4AB2.note: the same instruction sequence as RollChanceByLevel_100_100_75_0 (bank $36) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107)

7F:40CC.name: DrawMetaSpriteAt_Sets98
7F:40CC.note: the same instruction sequence as DrawMetaSpriteAt (bank $7F) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107) (E-0344: the address in its name dropped or read as the label there; was DrawMetaSpriteAt_40CC)

00:11DA.name: DarkenDMGPaletteByFadeLevel
00:11DA.note: A = a DMG palette byte (four 2-bit shades): each shade + wFadeLevel, capped at 3 (black), is packed back and stored at [HL] (DarkenDMGShade and DarkenDMGShadeNext) (E-0108)

00:11F5.name: DarkenDMGShade
00:11F5.note: adds B (the level) to the 2-bit shade in A & 3, caps it at 3, ORs it into C and rotates C right by 2 (E-0108)

00:11F0.name: DarkenDMGShadeNext
00:11F0.note: rotates D right by 2 to bring the next shade down, then DarkenDMGShade (E-0108)

00:1145.name: LightenDMGPaletteByFadeLevel
00:1145.note: A = a DMG palette byte: each 2-bit shade - wFadeLevel, at least 0 (white), is packed back and stored at [HL] (LightenDMGShade and LightenDMGShadeNext) (E-0108)

00:1160.name: LightenDMGShade
00:1160.note: subtracts B (the level) from the 2-bit shade in A & 3 (at least 0), ORs it into C and rotates C right by 2 (E-0108)

00:115B.name: LightenDMGShadeNext
00:115B.note: rotates D right by 2 to bring the next shade down, then LightenDMGShade (E-0108)

00:076B.name: ClearSGBPacketBuffer
00:076B.note: zero-fills the 16 bytes of wSGBPacketBuffer; BC, HL kept (E-0108)

00:08A6.name: ClearSTATInterruptSources
00:08A6.note: rSTAT &= $07: clears the LCD-status interrupt source bits 3-6, keeping the mode and coincidence flags (E-0108)

00:07D1.name: WaitSerialTransferDone
00:07D1.note: waits until rSC bit 7 (transfer in progress) clears (E-0108)

00:1F95.name: LoadRecordThreeBytesToTemp0
00:1F95.note: A = record, C = field offset (SRAMRecordAddress): copies three bytes from the record to hFFC6-hFFC8; HL kept (E-0108)

00:1022.name: CopySGBPacketFieldsAndSend
00:1022.note: copies 8 bytes from HL to DE, skips 2 source bytes, copies 6 more, then wSGBPacketIndex = $FF and far-calls SendSGBPacketSet (E-0108)

02:706E.name: CheckSaveData
02:706E.note: with SRAM bank 1 selected: hFFC6 = 1 when sBB00 is not the signature $55 (no save); otherwise 2 when VerifySaveBank1Checksum or VerifySaveBank3Checksum returns non-zero (damaged save), else 0 (valid); then disables SRAM (E-0109)

02:70A2.name: VerifySaveBank1Checksum
02:70A2.note: sums the $29A * 10 bytes of SRAM bank 1 from sBank1Records ($A06F) into the word DE, then returns A = 0 when sBank1Checksum ($BA73, little-endian) equals (~DE + $4321) & $FFFF and A = 1 otherwise, as CheckSaveData uses it (C2 from E-0323: after a save the stored word equals that value, and a fresh power-on offers CONTINUE)

02:7111.name: VerifySaveBank3Checksum
02:7111.note: sums the $333 * 10 = $1FFE bytes of SRAM bank 3 from sRecords ($A000) into the word DE, then returns A = 0 when the little-endian word right after them ($BFFE) equals (~DE + $1234) & $FFFF and A = 1 otherwise, as CheckSaveData uses it (C2 from E-0323, as VerifySaveBank1Checksum)

02:72B0.name: LoadSaveBlocksFromSRAM
02:72B0.note: with SRAM bank 1 mapped, walks LoadSaveBlocksFromSRAM_Data (word address, word length; a zero address ends it) and copies each block from sSaveData onward into WRAM, then sets wSaveStateFlag to $80 (renamed from CopySaveBlocksToSRAM: the copy goes from SRAM to WRAM, E-0366)

02:7598.name: CopySaveBlocksToSRAMWithSum
02:7598.note: the save's counterpart of LoadSaveBlocksFromSRAM: copies each block of LoadSaveBlocksFromSRAM_Data from WRAM to sSaveData onward while summing its bytes, then writes the signature $55 to sSaveSignature and the sum + $9753 to sSaveChecksumLo/Hi (E-0109, E-0366)

02:755E.name: SnapshotSpritesForSave
02:755E.note: wC83A = wCB7E and the $50 bytes of wSpriteSlots go to wC83B; then clears bit 1 of five object flag bytes at wC848, wC858, wC868, wC878 and wC888 (E-0109)

02:717D.name: RunLoadGameSteps
02:717D.note: with SRAM enabled, steps by wSaveStep: on the first call (0) sets it to 1, loads the saved WRAM blocks (LoadSaveBlocksFromSRAM), restores SRAM bank 2 from its bank-3 copy, the records from their bank-1 backup (RestoreRecordsFromSRAMBank1Backup) and the game-mode-2 timer block; while it is 1 unpacks one saved record per call (UnpackNextSavedRecord, which moves it on after record 30); then sets bit 7 of wSaveStep (finished); disables SRAM each time. It only reads the save (renamed from RunSaveSteps, E-0366)

02:72E9.name: LoadGM2TimerBlockFromSRAM
02:72E9.note: when sSavedGM2Mode is 0 or 1 copies the $D8 bytes at sSavedTimerBlock (SRAM bank 1) to wGM2TimerFrames; the counterpart of the save routine that writes them (E-0366)

02:7247.name: RestoreSRAMBank2FromBank3
02:7247.note: copies $1FFE bytes from SRAM bank 3 back to bank 2 at $A000 (the key-world slots and their saved copy, E-0366)

31:778E.name: ReadWordTableEntryForSlotC
31:778E.note: HL = table: HL = the word at HL + 2 * (C & 3) (falls into DerefHL_Bank31) (E-0110)

31:7797.name: DerefHL_Bank31
31:7797.note: HL = the word at HL; A = its low byte (E-0110)

31:7379.name: LoadMonsterPictureAttributesFromDE
31:7379.note: hFFC6 = C (palette number), DE = the monster id word stored at [DE], then LoadMonsterPictureAttributes (HL = BG map address from the caller); DE kept (E-0110)

31:7509.name: RunBattleSetup_PlanMenu_RedrawLowerRows
31:7509.note: copies a 7 x 1 rectangle from wC2A4 to vBGMap0 + $10C (row 8, column 12) and a 20 x 9 rectangle from wC2B8 to vBGMap0 + $120 (row 9), both with CopyRect32StrideToVRAM (E-0110) (E-0340: the address in its name read as its RAM name; was DrawWC2A4AndWC2B8Rects)

31:74A0.name: CopyScreenBufferRect12x11ToBGMapRow7
31:74A0.note: copies a 12 x 11 rectangle from wC278 (rows 32 bytes apart) to vBGMap0 + $E0 (row 7) with CopyRect32StrideToVRAM (E-0110) (E-0340: the address in its name read as its RAM name; was DrawWC278Rect12x11ToBGMapRow7)

31:71F5.name: ClearAttributesAndScreenBuffer_Bank31
31:71F5.note: on CGB writes 0 to the 20 x 18 visible attributes of vBGMap0 in VRAM bank 1 (rows 32 apart, WriteVRAMByteInc); then fills the $240 bytes of wScreenTileBuffer with $C3; what follows is not read (E-0110)

31:6DDD.name: ShowStringHL_Bank31
31:6DDD.note: wStringCategory = H, wStringIndex = L, then far-calls BeginStringDisplay_Bank2F (E-0110)

31:6286.name: ShowInventoryPageItemNames_EmptyEntry
31:6286.note: A = 0 (xor a, so Z set and carry clear); a two-byte handler stub (E-0110) (E-0344: the address in its name dropped or read as the label there; was ReturnZero_6286)

31:61A2.name: ShowSkillPageNames_EmptyEntry
31:61A2.note: A = 0 (xor a, so Z set and carry clear); a two-byte handler stub (E-0110) (E-0344: the address in its name dropped or read as the label there; was ReturnZero_61A2)

31:7806.name: DrawSlotHPDigits

36:4162.name: TryShuntOrGuard
36:4162.note: out of reach: 'But it failed to reach 0!'; else an ally guards the target (TryAllyGuard); else, when the target has its duck act (wPersonalityActs bit 5) or status 6 bit 5, it shunts the attack to the slot PickShuntSlot returns ('0 shunted the attack!', wOriginalTarget, wRedirectFlags bit 0) or fails ('0 failed to avert attack!') (E-0337)

36:421D.name: TryWindBounce
36:421D.note: when the target's status 2 bit 6 is set (a wind guard): clears it, shows 'The wind around 0 bounced the attack!', sets wAttackDeflected and turns the action back on the actor (TurnActionBackOnActor) (E-0337)

36:425A.name: TryWallOfLightBounce
36:425A.note: when the target's status 2 has bit 5 or 1 and the action's record byte 7 bit 7 (a spell): 'The wall of light bounced the spell!' (or text $C5 on the other side), sets wAttackDeflected and turns the action back on the actor (TurnActionBackOnActor) (E-0337)

36:42AA.name: CheckTargetOutOfReach
36:42AA.note: when the target is out of reach (status 3 or 4 bits) and the action's record byte 7 bit 5 is set: sound $84 and 'But it failed to reach 0!'; otherwise TryAllyGuard (E-0337)

36:42D3.name: TryAllyGuard
36:42D3.note: when the target's status 6 bit 4 is set and the action's record byte 6 bit 0: the ally in the high nibble of the next status byte, if able, takes the hit: wOriginalTarget = the target, the ally becomes the target, wAttackDeflected = 1, wRedirectFlags bit 1, text $CA '0 guarded <ally>!' (returns no carry with D = the text) (E-0337)

36:4317.name: ShowReactionTextAndCarry

36:4F18.name: PickShuntSlot

A3:4A5F.name: PickDuckBehindAlly
A3:4A5F.note: C = an ally the target can duck behind, or $FF (E-0337; was ResolveStepBegin_AdvanceRandom)

36:4EB1.name: TurnActionBackOnActor

1F:73EC.note: first call: draws the 6 x 6 frame Data_01F_651B and loads the picture of species wCA36 at vTiles2 + $200; second call: loads its CGB attributes and draws the picture (E-0128) (E-0340: the address in its name read as its RAM name; was DrawWCA36MonsterPictureInTwoSteps)

1F:76B5.name: DrawSummaryFrames
1F:76B5.note: draws the tile rectangles Data_01F_6E47 and Data_01F_6D6F, clears tile rows and sets up the summary text window (E-0128) (E-0344: the address in its name dropped or read as the label there; was DrawSummaryFrames6E47And6D6F)

30:483F.name: SortAIChoiceWeightsAndWeightSkills
30:483F.note: sorts wDA3C-wDA3E in descending order (ties broken by the random bits in wC5E7/8), swapping the matching wDA3F-wDA41 entries (E-0128)

31:7105.name: ShowSelectedSkillNameAndCost
31:7105.note: shows the name (category 9) of skill wD09D[4 * page + row] at vTiles2 + $260, loads its record and writes its MP cost (or the record's MP for skills $3D, $20, $7B) as digits at wC39E (E-0128)

32:4C9C.name: RollStatusTickEffect
32:4C9C.note: a random roll: 3/4 of the time nothing; otherwise clears status 3 (text $0F), loses a sixth of max HP (text $10) or of max MP, or does something else (E-0128)

32:4D99.name: PickRandomActionWhenUncontrolled
32:4D99.note: for an actor with status bits $C0 or $0C forces action $C9; otherwise picks action $C0, $C1 or a table action (Data_032_4E1C or 4E20) at random and stores it (E-0128)

32:5397.name: PayActorMPCost
32:5397.note: subtracts the skill's MP cost (wRecordBufferData) from the actor's MP; cost $FF takes all MP and saves it in wD866; marks the MP digits for redraw (E-0128)

32:55EE.name: CheckLinkRuleViolation
32:55EE.note: in link battles with rules on: an action forbidden by the wD044/wD045 rules (Data_032_5688) ends the battle with music 2 and a message for the side that broke it (E-0128)

36:4E26.name: LoadBattleMonsterPictureForSlotB
36:4E26.note: loads the picture of battle slot B (species at DE) into its picture area at vTiles2 + $140 + $240 * position and, on CGB, its attributes (E-0128)

36:5360.name: RaiseTargetDEF
36:5360.note: raises the target's DEF by a third (half for action $25) of its base DEF, limited by the buff cap; the actual gain is stored as damage (E-0128)

36:5441.name: RaiseTargetAGL
36:5441.note: raises the target's AGL by a third (half for action $29) of its base AGL, limited by the buff cap; the actual gain is stored as damage (E-0128)

37:5172.name: LinkBreed_StoreChildRecord
37:5172.note: when text is idle and not linking: copies the $A5-byte received record at wCAD0 into the record slot at WD789 cell 5 and resets the save counters (E-0128)

37:5A5D.name: CopyScreenBufferRectWithAttrs_37
37:5A5D.note: copies a wD7F1 x wD7F2 block inside the screen buffer from offset DE to offset HL for rows B to C, with CGB attributes (E-0128)

3A:5536.name: UploadBGPalettesWithFade
3A:5536.note: on CGB, when wC5E9 changed, writes the eight background palettes through Func_03A_55BB (rBGPI $80-$B8) (E-0128)

3A:6846.name: RunMultiHitCounter
3A:6846.note: sets up and counts down the multi-hit counter in wDABA (1 or 3 hits for action $63), choosing a new target for $63 when the old one is gone (E-0128)

3A:77D3.name: CheckAllTargetsSame
3A:77D3.note: counts equal pairs among the hFFC6 target words at wC0A0 (or wC0A8 for the foe side); when not all are equal writes a message to wC130 (E-0128)

60:4597.name: GenerateKeyWorld_RollEncounterTable
60:4597.note: clears wCE7B ($10 bytes) and fills a 4-byte entry per map area (from wCD7B) with a random monster id and level from the band lists (E-0128)

60:5075.name: CheckKeyWorldCellIsOpen
60:5075.note: reads the cell at (hFFC9, hFFCA) from the area map chunk in wCD60; A = 1 when its byte is not $FF, else 0 (E-0128)

E0:75BF.name: ResetScreenPalettes_E0
E0:75BF.note: sets the DMG palettes $D2/$D2/$E2 (also in wD040) and resets the fade; on the Super Game Boy blanks rBGP/rOBP, sends PAL_SET for wC51F and copies 8 bytes from $7641 to wC4FF (E-0128)

02:452C.name: WriteCGBObjPaletteFromDMGShadesDMGPaletteOBP0
02:452C.note: writes four colours of the palette at HL to rOBPD, each chosen by a 2-bit shade of wC5EA through Data_002_45C2; HL += 8 (E-0129)

02:4628.name: InitFieldScreen
02:4628.note: enters the field: loads the map header, resets scroll and timers, reorders the party, loads names and sprites, finds triggers, draws the map screen and places objects (E-0129)

02:5F9B.name: SendSGBFieldPaletteSet
02:5F9B.note: on the Super Game Boy sends PAL_SET for wC51F and loads the object palettes; wC5E0 1 becomes 2. The following entry clears the joypad state and runs the field mode states (E-0129)

02:737F.name: ComputeSRAMBank1RecordChecksum
02:737F.note: sums $29A * 10 bytes from sA06F in SRAM bank 1 and stores (~sum + $4321) & $FFFF, little-endian, at sBA73 (C2 from E-0323: recomputed from the cartridge RAM after a save it equals the stored word, 0 before)

03:592E.name: ShowInventoryPageItemNames_Bank03
03:592E.note: shows the four item names of inventory page wMenuPage (or the empty-inventory text and wC61E entries) at vTiles2 + $5C0 onward, preserving the window (E-0129)

03:67B0.name: ShowRecordSkillPageNames_Bank03
03:67B0.note: shows four skill names of record wC46D & 3 for page wMenuPage (or string $0E when it has none) at vTiles2 + $5C0 onward, preserving the window (E-0129)

05:50E3.name: PassIfFoeAverageDEFAtMostTwiceAllyATK
05:50E3.note: C = 1 when the AI mode is below 2; otherwise $FF when the foes' average DEF is at most twice the allies' average ATK, else $00 (E-0129)

05:5275.name: PassIfFoeAverageATKAtMostTwiceAllyDEF
05:5275.note: C = 1 when the AI mode is below 2; otherwise $FF when the able foes' average ATK is at most twice the allies' average DEF, else $00 (E-0129)

05:5919.name: AIGateLoneAllyMPAndSkills
05:5919.note: C = 1 when the AI mode is below 3; with exactly one other occupied ally that has at most 20 MP, checks its skills ($A0, $1E/$1F) and status; returns $00 or $FF (E-0129)

05:667F.name: AIGateCompareAllyStatAverages
05:667F.note: C = 1 when the AI mode is below 4 or the actor knows a heal skill; otherwise compares the stat sums of the empty and occupied ally slots and returns $00 or $FF (E-0129)

0A:42BC.name: EnterStatusEffectFieldState
0A:42BC.note: in the field (story flag 2, not in mode states 1 or 7, outside listed maps): when a party member has status bit 2 or 0 of field $55, switches to mode state 7 and toggles wC88C (E-0129)

12:5C3F.name: SpawnScriptSpriteInFrontOfPlayer
12:5C3F.note: decompresses sprite graphics from bank $7E to vTiles0 + $700 (with a CGB palette), places it 16 pixels in front of the player and advances wScriptStep (E-0129)

12:689A.name: GenerateNewKeyEntry
12:689A.note: writes a generated key (kind $FE) into a free key slot, rerolling while it duplicates an existing key, and saves the random seed in wC787; hFFC6 = 1, or 0 when the list is full (E-0129)

14:60E6.name: ToggleVoicingMarkOnNameEntry
14:60E6.note: on the last glyph of the name entry wCFAD adds or cycles the marks $8D and $8E when the glyph allows them (lists Data_014_688A and 68CA), with sound $69 (E-0129)

15:6478.name: HandleThreeOptionMenuInput_15
15:6478.note: up/down moves wD786 over three options with sound $69; A chooses (option 2 cancels), sets wTwoChoiceCursor and requests script $80; B cancels (E-0129)

04:44CE.name: UpdateAndDrawSpriteSlots
04:44CE.note: unless bit 7 of wC468 is set: updates the sprite slots, then draws each slot's metasprite at its position relative to the scroll (E-0129)

16:56E4.name: CollectUniqueEncounterIdsToWorkBuf2
16:56E4.note: for special maps copies the eight monster entries of the current screen (AddressOfKeyWorldMonstersEntryForCurrentScreen) to wD09F, removes duplicates and stores the count in wD09D; normal maps use Func_00A_4D5E (E-0129) (E-0340: the address in its name read as its RAM name; was CollectUniqueEncounterIdsToWD09F)

16:75EE.name: LoadSaveFileSummary
16:75EE.note: checks the save; when valid, loads the player name, play time, party summaries and other title-screen details from SRAM bank 1 into wD0D5 onward (E-0129)

16:78F9.name: DrawSaveSummaryPartyEntryC
16:78F9.note: for summary entry C (below B) loads its family icon, shows its 10-byte name and writes its level; otherwise blanks the entry (E-0129)

1C:6823.name: CopyRectToBGMapWrapped_1C
1C:6823.note: copies a B x C rectangle from DE to the BG map at HL, wrapping at the screen and map edges (E-0129)

1D:5F9C.name: MovePartyRecordsToFrontOfList
1D:5F9C.note: moves the party records found in the record list wD789 to its front and pads the list to $1E entries with $FF (E-0129)

1D:6088.name: DrawRecordListPageSpeciesNames
1D:6088.note: for the visible entries of page wD7AF draws the species name (field $0B, category 2 of the bank-08 database) of each listed record (E-0129)

1F:5D9A.name: FillTileRectWithArg1Tile
1F:5D9A.note: fills a wArg3 x wArg4 rectangle of the BG map at wArg5/6 (wrapping inside the 32-entry row) with the one tile byte at wArg1/2: unlike DrawTileRectFromArg1Params it never advances DE; on CGB, unless wArg7 is set, clears the same entries' attributes; every caller passes BGFillTile (E-0186, correcting E-0129)

1F:7601.name: ShowRecordBufBSkillNamesOrNone
1F:7601.note: shows the eight skill names of the record at wCA2B (field $34) in rows from vTiles2 + $200, or string $0E of category 8 when it has none (E-0129)

30:4AD3.name: ScoreActionsWithAIScoreTableA
30:4AD3.note: sets wDA6B/C to AIScoreRoutineTableA; for AI-controlled actors estimates damage, scores the eight skills, attack (0) and $AC into wD2AD, and doubles the weight of the preferred kind (E-0129)

32:514C.name: CheckFormationPartnersCanAct
32:514C.note: for the actor and its formation partner checks status blocks and MP costs of their stored actions (wDA2C) and returns flags in hFFC7 (E-0129)

36:5223.name: HealTargetHP
36:5223.note: restores the target's HP by the rolled skill amount, or fully for actions $20, $B1, $7B, $DA (with other cases for $18, $1A, $CF), capped at its max HP (E-0129)

37:5BC6.name: PackRecordBufAToLinkWorkBuf
37:5BC6.note: unpacks the received partner record at wC986 into wD09D: names, species, family, parents, skills and scaled stats (E-0129)

37:5E3E.name: ScaleStatWordsToLinkFormat
37:5E3E.note: converts three stat words at DE: 999 becomes $01FF/$00FF, otherwise word * $33 or $19 / 100 rounded up; stores them at HL (E-0129)

3A:4A3A.name: SetEffectSpriteXForTargets
3A:4A3A.note: sets wD804 (and the wD805 list for all targets) to the screen X of the target from Data_03A_4AD5 by wDAB9 and the side count wD890 (E-0129)

3A:7508.name: ShowActionRefusedMessage
3A:7508.note: copies the actor, skill and target names to wC130/wC140/wC150 and picks the action message from Data_03A_7603 (or special messages $49-$4C) (E-0129)

3A:785A.name: WriteTargetNameOrTheMonsters
3A:785A.note: when the hFFC6 targets are all the same, copies the target name to wC130; otherwise writes "The monsters" (E-0129)

3A:7AE3.name: ListSideMonsterIdsToTemp0
3A:7AE3.note: clears wC0A0 ($10 bytes) and lists the species ids of the occupied slots of the shown side at wC0A0 and of the other side at wC0A8 (E-0129) (E-0340: the address in its name read as its RAM name; was ListSideMonsterIdsToWC0A0)

3B:4990.name: RollTableDamageScaledByResistance
3B:4990.note: actions $24 onward: damage = random in the range from Data_03B_4A24[action - $24], then scaled by the target's resistance level for that element (85 percent at level 1, less above) (E-0129)

3B:4D1C.name: ItemEffect_BadMeat
3B:4D1C.note: reduces the target's wD93F (or adds to wD89F for local targets); when status bits 0-1 are clear and the chance roll passes, sets status bit 0 (message $75) (E-0129)

60:4274.name: GenerateKeyWorld_RollMonsters_Boss
60:4274.note: fills 8 two-byte entries from wCD50 with random monster ids from the band lists (Data_060_4123 row wCD02) (E-0129)

60:4607.name: GenerateKeyWorld_RollEncounterTableAlt
60:4607.note: like GenerateKeyWorld_RollEncounterTable, with each entry's level from wCD05 / 5 * 7 plus the area value, capped at 99 (E-0129)

60:4FEA.name: PlaceTwoRandomOpenCells
60:4FEA.note: picks two random open cells (CheckKeyWorldCellIsOpen) in the areas named by hFFC7 and hFFC8, avoiding the previous cell, and stores their positions (E-0129)

60:62F9.name: RefreshKeyWorldObjectsOnEntry
60:62F9.note: on key-world maps with bit 7 of wC893 set: sets the object count wCC47 from the band of the key level and drops objects for which Func_060_53E5 fails; marks the wC890 object (E-0129)

61:55AF.name: DrawKeyWorldAreaExitTilesForScreen
61:55AF.note: for the wCD7B entry on the current screen writes its 2 x 2 tile block ($46, or $70-$73) at wC240 with CGB attribute 5 (E-0129)

61:606D.name: KeyWorldAreaEncounterIndex
61:606D.note: hFFC6 = 1 when bit 7 of wCD07 is set; otherwise on map types $80/$85 the wCE7E entry of the current area (wCD74), else 0 (E-0129)

85:5DB9.name: AddHundredToPartyINTCapped999
85:5DB9.note: for each party record adds 100 to the INT word (field $69), capped at 999; far-called by Talk00FC_YouHaveToEat (E-0129)

F0:6AFE.name: RaiseLowestResistances
F0:6AFE.note: while wCE9E > 0 and some resistance at wCF41 is below 3: picks at random one of the lowest-level resistances (levels 0, then 1, 2) and raises it (E-0129)

F1:4307.name: ShowInventoryPageItemNames_BankF1
F1:4307.note: shows the four item names of inventory page wMenuPage (or the empty-inventory text and wC61E entries) at vTiles2 + $5C0 onward, preserving the window (E-0129)

F2:4B05.name: DrawRecordBufBExpAndExpToNextLevel
F2:4B05.note: writes the EXP wCA83-wCA85 as seven digits and, below the level cap, the EXP still needed for the next level (E-0129) (E-0340: the address in its name read as its RAM name; was DrawWCA83ExpAndToNextLevel)

F2:4F47.name: DrawLevelAndStatusRowForRecordBufBLevel
F2:4F47.note: writes the level wCA81 (marked $6F at the cap wCA82), its digits and the status marks from wCA80 into the BG map (E-0129) (E-0340: the address in its name read as its RAM name; was DrawLevelAndStatusRowForWCA81)

F2:65E6.name: ClampPartyHPAndMPToMax
F2:65E6.note: for each party record sets HP (field $5B) and MP (field $5F) down to their maxima when they exceed them (E-0129)

00:13E5.name: LoadSGBBorderForSetA
00:13E5.note: when A differs from wC523: sends the Super Game Boy border tiles, map and palettes of set A through three compressed transfers (SGBTransferCompressed) (E-0130)

00:1906.name: LoadSpecialMapScreen
00:1906.note: for the current map screen decompresses its tile block (chunk table in bank $61, indexed by hFFC6 and the screen position) into wScreenTileBuffer, and on CGB its attributes (E-0130)

00:1EA5.name: DrawScreenBufferToBGMapWithAttrs
00:1EA5.note: copies the 20 x 13 screen-buffer area (offset by bit 7 of wC8CB) to the BG map at HL, wrapping, and on CGB its attributes from WRAM bank 2 (E-0130)

02:64E5.name: OpenFieldMenuOnA
02:64E5.note: in the field, when A is pressed and nothing blocks it: saves the screen, sets the object flags and draws the field menu windows (Data_002_6606, 6642) (E-0130)

02:66CC.name: ShowIdlePartyStatusWindow
02:66CC.note: in the field, after $B4 idle frames: saves the bottom of the screen and shows the party status window (level, HP, MP) (E-0130)

02:6788.name: BuildPartyStatusWindowRows
02:6788.note: for each party member writes level (field $56), HP (field $5B) and MP (field $5F) into the status window at wC364 (offsets Data_002_6835) (E-0130)

02:69D0.name: StepTextWindowOpenClose
02:69D0.note: while wC8CB & 3 is set: copies the text window rows to or from wC300 (with CGB attributes) and redraws them at the scroll position (E-0130)

04:4025.name: SetupKeyWorldObjectsForMapType
04:4025.note: for key-world map types 2, 3, 4 and 6 places the area objects (stairs, chests, monsters) from the wCD89/wCDAC entries (E-0130)

05:585D.name: CompareFoeAverageATKWithAllyDEF
05:585D.note: compares twice the occupied foes' average ATK with the allies' average DEF; returns $00 or $FF in C (E-0130)

0A:561E.name: AdvanceStepCounterAndUpdateStoredRecords
0A:561E.note: counts steps in wC7C9 (wrapping at 1000); every 100 steps and at 1000 updates the stored SRAM records by their state byte and field $6E (E-0130)

0D:5D26.name: DrawKeyListPageMarks
0D:5D26.note: blanks the four mark positions and draws marks for the keys on the current page of wD789 (E-0130)

0D:5DED.name: DrawKeyListPageNames
0D:5DED.note: for the keys on the current page writes their names to wC8CF and draws them; generated keys (kind $FE) are shown as "Magic Key" (E-0130)

0E:59E1.name: AdjustStatForRecordBufAAndBItems
0E:59E1.note: when wCA2A or wCACF is set and listed for stat C (Data_00E_5A6B), subtracts Data_00E_5A8E[value] from DE (unless it is at 999) (E-0130) (E-0340: the address in its name read as its RAM name; was AdjustStatForWCA2AAndWCACF) (E-0345: $CA2A and $CACF are the MON_ITEM of wRecordBufA and wRecordBufB; was AdjustStatForRecordBufAByte7133AndRecordBufBItem)

0E:5EE8.name: ApplyBreedingBonusToChildStats
0E:5EE8.note: computes a bonus from personality compatibility, matching parent fields and wD7F1, and adds it to the child stats at wCAD0 (offsets Data_00E_5F89) (E-0130)

12:69B0.name: DeleteKeyEntryTemp0
12:69B0.note: removes key entry hFFC6: clears the matching wC88E link, marks its SRAM-bank-2 slot free and shifts the later entries down (E-0130)

12:722A.name: DrawTriggerMarkerSprite
12:722A.note: unless bit 7 of wC468 is set or no trigger is active (wC8FE = $FF), draws the trigger marker sprite (Data_012_7308) at the trigger cell wC8FF (E-0130)

12:7BCC.name: RunPendingFieldEventPendingFieldEvent
12:7BCC.note: on town maps runs the pending event in wC935 (bits 7 and 6 select the stage; some kinds need wC634); otherwise clears it (E-0130)

16:64DC.name: ListPartyAndStoredRecordsForPage
16:64DC.note: lists the party records and then the stored records (state 1, field $6E clear) in wD789 and sets the page counts wCFD0-wCFD3 (E-0130)

16:65FF.name: MovePagedListCursor
16:65FF.note: up/down/left/right move the cursor at [DE] and the page wCFD1 within the page sizes wCFD0/wCFD3 and page count wCFD2 (E-0130)

19:434D.name: LoadSlotSkillsFromBattlerRecord
19:434D.note: for slot C clears its skill list and copies the skills from its 78-byte battler record, then loads each skill record (with wD868 = 3) (E-0130)

19:49B1.name: AccumulateGrowthForLevelsTemp1
19:49B1.note: sums the stat word at record + $18 times each level 1..hFFC7 (with a /20 rounding term outside battle kind 3) into the 24-bit hFFCA-hFFCC (E-0130)

1B:7399.name: ListAvailableRecordsForSelection
1B:7399.note: lists in wD789 the stored records (state 1, or 2 unless wD7DC is 3) whose field $6E is clear and that are not already chosen in wD7DD; count in wD7A9 (E-0130)

33:5F99.name: ListAvailableRecordsForSelection_Bank33
33:5F99.note: lists in wD789 the stored records (state 1, or 2 unless wD7DC is 3) whose field $6E is clear and that are not already chosen in wD7DD; count in wD7A9 (E-0130)

1D:6320.name: DrawRecordListPageMarks
1D:6320.note: for the visible entries of page wD7AF draws each record's mark ($CC/$CD from field $0E, or $CE for state 2) beside it (E-0130)

1E:6FEB.name: DrawRecordFamilyEntries
1E:6FEB.note: for record B draws the species names and marks named by the field lists $70D7 or $70DD (by bit 4 of field $0D), or a blank tile for missing entries (E-0130) (E-0344: the address in its name dropped or read as the label there; was DrawRecordFamilyEntries_6FEB)

1E:725D.name: DrawRecordLevelAndStatusRow_1E
1E:725D.note: writes the record's level (field $56, marked $6F at the cap in field $57) and its status marks into the BG map at scroll + $29 (E-0130)

30:46BA.name: AddStatusAndHPWeightsToAI
30:46BA.note: adds AI weights for the actor's status (wD80D bits) and command mode, and for allies below a sixth of max HP in AI modes 3 and 4 (E-0130)

36:6346.name: RollChanceByLevel_100_100_75_40Percent
36:6346.note: level A: 0 and 1 return, 2 and 3 take chance rolls; the following entries roll random values against $D8, $BF, $7F, $66, $4C, $3F and $26 (E-0130) (E-0344: the address in its name dropped or read as the label there; was RollChanceForLevelA_6346)

3A:4ADB.name: RunBattleEffectAnimation
3A:4ADB.note: runs the battle effect animation state wD800: loads the effect graphics, steps the effect sprite and its X positions, and ends the effect (E-0130)

60:408F.name: GenerateKeyWorld_RollMonsters_Normal
60:408F.note: fills 32 two-byte entries from wCD10 with random monster ids from the wCCF7 band lists (rows from Data_060_4123 by wCD02) (E-0130)

60:53E5.name: PlaceKeyWorldObjectAtRandomCell
60:53E5.note: picks a random open cell within wCD0D x wCD0E not used by another object and stores it for object hFFC6 (E-0130)

60:54BB.name: RollKeyWorldObjectKind
60:54BB.note: picks an object kind for the key level band wCD0F from the chance rows at $556F and its contents ([DE + 1]) (E-0130)

60:639D.name: SetupTownObjectsForMap
60:639D.note: on town maps with bit 7 of wC893 set: sets the object count and band for the map, drops listed objects and marks the wC890 one (E-0130)

61:4001.name: ComputePartyStrengthLevelPartyStrength
61:4001.note: wCD05 = a strength value from the party's stats (AGL and INT halved, ATK, DEF, max HP), 0 without a party (E-0130)

61:474C.name: DrawKeyWorldExitTile
61:474C.note: draws the exit or stairs tile block for the current screen when it matches the area entry in wCE2D (E-0130)

61:54EC.name: DrawKeyWorldGoalAtScreen
61:54EC.note: on key-world maps draws the goal object for the current screen (from wC88F when the wC891 key matches, else from wCD0A) (E-0130)

61:562F.name: DrawKeyWorldFloorInfo3ObjectTilesForScreen
61:562F.note: for the wCD8B object on the current screen draws its 4 x 2 or 2 x 2 tile blocks by kind (E-0130) (E-0340: the address in its name read as its RAM name; was DrawWCD8BObjectTilesForScreen)

61:58BC.name: CheckKeyWorldWarpTable
61:58BC.note: checks the warp list Data_061_6566[wCDAC entry] against the current screen and warps when one matches; C = 0 when none (E-0130)

85:5B53.name: SetupMap0BMonsterObjects
85:5B53.note: on map $0B places four monster objects and picks the monster for the wC82C / wD7FF entry (table $5C5E) or a random one (E-0130)

F0:6BE0.name: RankFamilyScoresIntoFamilyRanking
F0:6BE0.note: ranks the 11 scores at wCEC3 in descending order (ties at random) into wCF7E, then wCF8A = BandOfFamilyBitCount (E-0130)

00:0150.name: BootAndMainLoop
00:0150.note: entry after the header jump: wIsCGB = 1 when A was $11 at power-on; disables interrupts, sets the stack, clears RAM, installs the OAM DMA routine, clears VRAM, sets game mode 5 and the MBC banks, then runs the main loop (E-0131)

01:57E1.name: DebugToggleArg1Marker
01:57E1.note: debug: toggles wD7F1 between 0 and 2 and writes tile $10 + wD7F1 at vBGMap0 + $81; the following entries are the debug results screen input handlers (E-0131)

01:66AD.name: DebugBattleSetup_CopyMonsterId
01:66AD.note: debug battle setup: copies a word from DE to HL (a zero word becomes 1); the following entries load the setup into wCFDD-wCFE5 and handle input (E-0131)

01:6903.name: DebugBattleSetupShowFieldString

The actor's MP minus the cost is computed in HL; a negative result returns with D = 1 (not enough MP) and carry clear. Equal MP and cost succeeds (D = 0, carry set). 00:3F04.name: DivideHLByBC
00:3F04.note: HL = HL / BC (quotient), BC = HL mod BC; clobbers A, DE
00:3F04.evidence: reading, re-read against the code (E-0353); also execution (tests/test_routine_behaviour.py)

00:3ED4.name: AdvanceRandom

00:3E98.name: RandomInRange
00:3E98.note: HL = minimum, BC = maximum: returns DE = minimum + (random mod (maximum - minimum + 1)), the random value being wC5E8:wC5E7 after AdvanceRandom; DE = HL when the two are equal (73 call sites)
00:3E98.evidence: reading, re-read against the code (E-0353); also execution (tests/test_routine_behaviour.py)

36:5025.name: ComputeBasicDamage
36:5025.note: the damage formula: HL = the acting slot's value from the array at wD8FF (Func_036_7E2E), BC = the value to compare with, set by the caller. If HL <= BC the damage is RandomInRange(0, 1). Otherwise, with half = (HL - BC) / 2: when HL / 16 >= half the damage is RandomInRange(0, HL / 16); else it is half + RandomInRange(-(half / 16), half / 16) + RandomInRange(-1, 1). The 16-bit result goes to wBattleDamageLo/Hi. The divisors are 16, not 4: ShiftHLRight4 falls through two more shifts (corrected in E-0064)

36:7E2E.name: GetBattleATK
36:7E2E.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot in the array at wD8FF (Func_036_7E5B)

36:7E33.name: GetBattleDEF

36:7E47.name: GetBattleMP
